author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
QuickBooks Payroll is now QuickBooks Workforce, and this tutorial walks you through everything new, from the AI agent that runs payroll to the full HR side, updated for 2026. 
💵 Try QuickBooks Workforce ➜ https://qbworkforce.kevinstratvert.com/

First, you'll walk through the three plans, Workforce Payroll, Premium, and Elite, so you know which features sit behind which tier before you pay.

Then, you'll meet the new Payroll AI Agent, which texts your team for their hours, flags anything that looks off, and drafts the payroll run so all you do is review and approve.

Along the way, you'll learn why the Agent runs per employee, so you can use it for your hourly team while your salaried folks stay on Auto Payroll.

After that, you'll post a job with the new recruiting tools, publish it to ZipRecruiter, and let QuickBooks pull the key details out of every resume for you.
